title: Eva Longoria: « My greatest success is still in front of me »
summary: 🎞️ For the 21st time, one of the world’s most celebrated actresses and filmmakers returns to the red carpet at the Cannes Film Festival. ☕📽️ Eva Longoria opens up about what she wishes she had known before her very first Cannes experience, shares some of her most memorable moments, reflects on her passion for cinema and filmmaking and reveals what’s next…
